seo.description: Licensed telehealth evaluation for eligible midlife and metabolic concerns, opening by state.

data.headline: Licensed care for the changes
data.subhead: Explore telehealth evaluation for eligible midlife and metabolic concerns with licensed providers.

background_image.alt: A woman talks with a provider on a video call from her living room.

data.heading: Hear when care opens
data.body: Tell us where you live and we'll email you when licensed telehealth care is available there. Please don't include symptoms, diagnoses or medications.
data.consent_label: Also send me Bell Curve Health news and education. (Optional)
data.success_message: You're on the list. We'll email you when care is available in your state.
data.privacy_note: We use this only to tell you about care availability. See our Privacy Policy.

data.heading: Availability first,
data.lead: A licensed provider may need more information or a live visit. Treatment and prescriptions are never guaranteed.

steps.title: Check availability
steps.body: See whether clinical care is available in your state.

steps.title: Complete the clinical intake
steps.body: If it is, complete the separate, secure medical intake the care provider requires.

steps.title: Review your options
steps.body: A licensed provider reviews your information and determines what care, if any, may be appropriate. If it is, you'll see the recommended care and final costs before you proceed.

data.heading: Weight + metabolic health
data.body: Evaluation for changes in weight, appetite and metabolic health, including GLP-1 evaluation when clinically appropriate. Other categories appear here only when our clinical partner supports them.

features.title: Education and the Health Map
features.body: The BCH Health Map and educational resources can help you organize what you're noticing. They are not medical evaluations.

features.title: Already have a doctor?
features.body: BCH education and the Health Map can help you prepare for clearer conversations with your own providers.

data.body: Clinical decisions are made separately by a licensed provider based on the provider's clinical intake and evaluation.
